title: PortContract
description: The published descriptor of one Port Contract: which document schemas cross the port, who owns its semantics, and the content addresses that pin its lifecycle, authority, vocabulary, configuration, and conformance material. Every file under contracts/port-contracts/ is an instance of this schema. A Port Contract names schemas and digests only; it carries no implementation, endpoint, credential, or provider selection.

semantic_owner.description: The owner of this port's semantics. Closed at the one owner every published Port Contract names. A Port Contract owned by anything else is not an Agents-owned port and does not belong in this directory; widening this enum is a deliberate act, not an accident of authoring.

SchemaReference.description: One document schema crossing this port, pinned by content address. The digest is the SHA-256 of the published schema file's exact bytes, so editing a schema without republishing the Port Contract is a detectable break rather than a silent one.
